model.C: Spectral norm balls on U and V
model.g: Indicator of D={U>=0, entrywise ||V||_1<=s}; V signed

finite_sum.sampling: Fresh uniform fixed-size image subsets without replacement within each batch
finite_sum.estimator: Average of component gradients, with V gradients embedded in their respective rows
finite_sum.unbiasedness: Each index inclusion probability b/n gives E[(1/b)sum_{j in S} grad q_j]=grad f. Conditional statement holds because each subset is drawn independently of the past.
finite_sum.variance: Bounded second moment on compact C; averaging is unbiased; momentum itself is a biased recursive estimator and is not asserted unbiased.

global_smoothness.issue: Quartic factorization is smooth on compact C but its gradient is not globally Lipschitz on the ambient space.
global_smoothness.extension: For each component use chi(||(U,V)||_F^2/(2*R2))*q_j, R2=rank*(RU^2+RV^2). chi(s)=1 for s<=1; chi(s)=0 for s>=2; for t=s-1 in (0,1), chi(s)=1-10*t^3+15*t^4-6*t^5.
global_smoothness.justification: C lies in s<=1/2; extension agrees with objective and gradients on a neighborhood of every feasible query. The extension is C2 with compact support, hence has globally bounded Hessian and gradient. No numerical cutoff evaluation is needed.
global_smoothness.numerical_schedule_scale: L_full_bound is the original objective bound on C, used only to choose arbitrary positive mu0 prefactors; not advertised as the global cutoff Lipschitz constant.

constraints.C: Nonempty compact convex product, finite-dimensional LMO available via thin SVD
constraints.g: Proper lower-semicontinuous convex indicator; Moreau gradient (x-Proj_D(x))/mu
constraints.ri_qualification: Choose every entry of U small and strictly positive and V=0, with strict spectral bounds and strict l1 budget. This lies in the interiors of both sets.
constraints.regularity: The interior intersection gives bounded linear regularity on the compact C domain.

update.momentum: Initialize with first sampled smooth gradient; update only the smooth-gradient momentum; add positive Moreau penalty afterward.
update.sign: Use + (x-Proj_D(x))/mu, the gradient of the squared-distance envelope.
update.initialization: Shared nonzero feasible data-scaled random positive factors; avoid zero-factor stationary saddle.

numerics.LMO: Minimum-Frobenius polar on numerically nonzero singular directions; support-gap upper bound recorded. Floating-point operation, not claimed literally exact.
numerics.prox_D: Positive-part on U; exact-arithmetic l1 projection on V, implemented numerically.

reporting.loss: Raw objective and independently feasible repaired objective; repair never enters optimization.
reporting.stationarity: True full-gradient smoothed FW gap at probes only; not the all-iterate average required by the theorem.
reporting.optimality: Unconstrained rank-r SVD tail is a lower bound, not an achievable constrained optimum.
reporting.time: Optimizer includes gradient, estimator, projection on D, LMO, and update; diagnostic repair, metrics, initialization, checkpoint IO excluded.

validation: 29 tests passed, including finite differences, exact oracle expectation, spectral LMO support, projection certificates, and bitwise checkpoint continuation.
